title: 2. Neurogenic Bladder & Urinary Tract Infections (UTI)
source_document: English Master Data Collection & Clinical Content Repository

items: Etiology: Loss of supraspinal autonomic control leading to detrusor hyperreflexia, detrusor-sphincter dyssynergia (DSD), or flaccid detrusor weakness.
UTI Risk: Urinary stasis, high storage pressures, incomplete emptying, and indwelling catheterization significantly elevate bacterial colonization risks.

Prevention Concepts: General urinary management education emphasizes techniques such as clean/sterile intermittent catheterization, adequate fluid intake, and regular urological monitoring to support bladder health and reduce infection risks. Specific catheter routines and fluid goals must be individualized with a clinician.
